lot_5_6_approved_concepts.current: Acquire all future provider data from today until provider future exhaustion; J+30 is only the configurable hot window
lot_5_6_approved_concepts.finalization: 30-day default configurable finalization period with anomaly if provider still does not identify event as finished
lot_5_6_approved_concepts.recent_catchup: Past portion of current season during initial bootstrap only
lot_5_6_approved_concepts.deep_history: Previous seasons until provider exhaustion; five consecutive valid empty seasons by default
lot_5_6_approved_concepts.priority: finalization approximately current-hot > current-future > recent_catchup > deep_history while preserving 5.4 fairness
lot_5_6_approved_concepts.source_storage: Durable structured replayable source representation without full-version duplication
lot_5_6_approved_concepts.identity: provider_instance_id + championship_source_id + entity_kind + external_id, with explicit synthetic source key fallback
lot_5_6_approved_concepts.absence: Only after complete provider traversal and always non-destructive in 5.6
lot_5_6_approved_concepts.checkpoint: Advance only after durable successful unit persistence; invalid cursor restarts smallest safe unit
lot_5_6_approved_concepts.pre_1970: No positive Unix timestamp assumption or zero-date sentinel
lot_5_6_approved_concepts.manual_overrides: Provider acquisition updates source but never destroys active local override
lot_5_6_approved_concepts.security: ADR-0016 outbound HTTPS allowlist, redirects, timeout, bounded streaming and redaction apply without exception
lot_5_6_approved_concepts.boundary_5_7: Source graph is technical only; no final business normalization, merging or Event-to-Sessions model is introduced in 5.6

next_action.task: Maintainer audits and revalidates the 5.7-P-E integration correction on VPS. Do not start 5.7-P-F, activate Preview in Production, onboard an external client, authorize full Lot 5.7 or Lot 5.8+, or merge main.
